title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Has this (or will this) happened to you?
Fuckkkk. Did they say how long?
One week this month and next two
So one week from April through June?
God dammit. I’m sorry dude. What else do they have you writing then besides Tigers stuff?
Eh, it’s whatever. It’s a lot worse for other people that got laid off
I mean, it’s not “whatever,” it sucks - I’m not getting paid - but yeah.
I wasn’t allowed to do anything on furlough, back on Tigers this week
9/1/2017 0:14:55 “Fuck it,” I texted him, and hit the button. 9/1/2017 0:16:12 “I’m so nervous.”
Ended up working out for you.
Those text messages to “TEX Hank Hill”
I picked Hank Hill because H comes after G in the alphabet, H-H like W-W (Walter White)
